cues: Copper is the oldest worked metal: the repousse work of the Kathmandu valley and the gilded roofs of Pashupatinath.
Its chief ore is copper pyrite, copper iron sulphide.
Other ores are copper glance, cuprite, and the green and blue carbonates malachite and azurite.
